elements.name: q1
elements.title: An icon-only button deletes a draft. Which name communicates its purpose?
elements.feedback: The name should describe the action.

elements.name: q2
elements.title: A purely decorative image adds no information. What indicates it can be skipped?
elements.feedback: An empty alternative indicates decoration; a missing attribute may trigger a fallback.

elements.name: q3
elements.title: A chart conveys important trends and values. What is an appropriate alternative?
choices: Identify the chart and provide equivalent information nearby
elements.correctAnswer: Identify the chart and provide equivalent information nearby
elements.feedback: The meaningful data and relationships must remain available.
